limitations: Local graph execution and strict media-alignment admission are implemented; effect quality, semantic depth adherence, preservation quality, temporal consistency, hardware requirement, and platform compatibility remain unqualified.
The workflow consumes an already preprocessed, frame-aligned depth video and does not derive depth from the source video.

Admission verifies stored hashes, grayscale depth encoding, dimensions, decoded frame count, and every 16 FPS timestamp. It cannot prove that each depth frame semantically corresponds to its source frame; the caller must supply a correctly preprocessed depth sequence.
Output frame rate and geometry follow the decoded source video; no FPS, duration, timeline, or segment control exists in this recipe.
Mute only: source audio is not carried into the output.
